name: pocket-money-pal
description: Chores, pocket money, savings goals and a sprinkle of game mechanics for kids.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pmp/server" "npm run dev -w @pmp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pmp/web && npm run build -w @pmp/server
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @pmp/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @pmp/desktop
scripts.desktop:release: npm run build && npm run release -w @pmp/desktop
